I have farmed this land for many years and know what my soil needs. I will spread the compost and manure I have saved from my animals, and I will also buy some chemical fertilizer from the farmers' cooperative because the wheat needs extra strength. I will plant the seed I kept from last year's harvest, and my children and I will do the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves, though I may need to hire a few workers when the cutting is heavy. We have no irrigation water here, so I wait for the rains, and I do not have money for pesticides.
